function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### Best Men’s Underwear Styles (and What Makes Them Great) | Style | Key Features | Ideal For | Pros | Cons | |-------|--------------|-----------|------|------| | **Briefs** | Tight‑fit, high cut, full coverage | Everyday wear, active use | • Excellent support
• Minimal bunching
• Good for tight pants | • Can feel restrictive
• Less breathable if made from synthetic fibers | | **Boxers** | Loose fit, low cut, long leg | Casual, lounging | • Breathable
• Comfortable for all-day wear | • Lack support
• Can cause friction when wearing tight jeans | | **Boxer Briefs** | Hybrid of briefs & boxers | Versatile, athletic | • Support + breathability
• Reduces chafing | • May still bunch up under tight trousers | | **Trunks** | Shorter leg than boxer briefs, higher waist | Trendy, fashion-forward | • Modern look
• Good support
• Less bulk | • Not ideal for very loose pants | | **Performance Underwear** | Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, quick‑dry | Sports, travel | • Keeps you dry
• Odor control
• Lightweight | • Usually more expensive
• Limited color options | | **Bamboo / Modal** | Natural fibers, soft, eco-friendly | Sensitive skin, eco-conscious | • Softest feel
• Hypoallergenic
• Sustainable | • Can be pricier
• Requires careful washing | | **Seamless** | No seams, minimal stitching | Comfort, no irritation | • No chafing
• Smooth under clothing | • May not offer enough support for some activities | --- #### How to Choose the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Daily Activities** - *Active*: Performance underwear or boxer briefs. - *Office/Business*: Briefs or trunks for a polished look. - *Relaxation*: Boxers or bamboo for maximum comfort. 2. **Think About Fabric** - **Cotton** – Classic, breathable, but may retain moisture. - **Microfiber / Polyester blends** – Durable, moisture‑wicking. - **Modal / Bamboo** – Ultra-soft, eco-friendly, good for sensitive skin. - **Spandex / Lycra** – Adds stretch and shape retention. 3. **Fit Matters** - Try different cuts; what feels snug in one brand might feel loose in another. - Look for adjustable waistbands or elastic bands that stay in place without digging into your skin. 4. **Brand Recommendations** - **Calvin Klein** – Iconic briefs/trunks with a classic fit. - **Hanes** – Affordable, reliable cotton briefs. - **Uniqlo** – Airism line offers breathable, moisture‑wicking fabric. - **Under Armour** – Performance underwear with sweat‑wicking technology. - **Lululemon** – High‑quality, stretchy boxer briefs. - **Tommy John** – Seamless, ultra‑soft briefs with a modern fit. - **Pact** – Organic cotton, eco‑friendly options. 5. **Maintenance Tips** - Wash in cold water to preserve elasticity. - Avoid bleach unless the label says it’s safe. - Dry on low heat or air dry to prevent shrinkage. --- #### Quick Summary - **For everyday support**: **Briefs** or **boxer briefs**. - **For casual, relaxed wear**: **Boxers** or **bamboo/modal**. - **For sports or travel**: **Performance underwear**. - **For a trendy look**: **Trunks** or **seamless** styles. Ultimately, the “best” style depends on personal preference, body type, and lifestyle. Experiment with a few different cuts and fabrics to find what feels most comfortable and supportive for you. Happy shopping!
